title: Armed Civilian Intervention (ACI) case record
description: One record = one incident. Sources are NOT stored here: every incident has one or more rows in data/sources.csv (see schema/source.schema.json). A record with no source row is invalid.

incident_id.description: US-<year>-<state>-<sourceprefix><nnn>. Prefix A=ALERRT, D=independent news sweep, E=secondary list.

status.description: Only 'verified' records may be used in published counts.

confidence.description: A=primary record (court/police/prosecutor/coroner); B=official dataset (FBI/ALERRT); C=two or more independent news sources; D=single news source; E=secondary compilation only. Verified requires A, B or C.

gun_free_zone.description: Was lawful carry prohibited at the location at the time? Drives the sub-analysis of intervention rates where carry is allowed.

killed_before.description: Deaths before the intervention took effect. Blank = not yet coded.

killed_after.description: Deaths after the intervention took effect, INCLUDING any caused by the intervener.

intervener_type.description: 'citizen_claimed' is a placeholder for secondary-list records not yet resolved. Only civilian and volunteer_security count toward the citizen total.

intervener_detail.description: Role, permit status, how armed, occupation if relevant.

mechanism.description: How the intervention ended the attack. 'no_effect' is mandatory for counter-cases.

seconds_to_intervention.description: Seconds from first shot to intervener action, where documented.

attacker_had_stopped_firing.description: Had the attacker already ceased firing when the intervention occurred? Separates death-prevention from ending an escape.

prevented_further_deaths.description: Coders must justify; 'yes' requires evidence the attacker had capacity and intent to continue.
